title: Ahold Delhaize USA adds Pear Commerce to connect CPG content to online grocery carts
description:

title: HubSpot AEO vs. Scrunch: Which tool fits your workflow?
description: If you’re evaluating answer engine optimization tools, here’s the short version: HubSpot AEO is an insight-to-execution platform that connects AI visibility data directly to your CRM and content workflows. Scrunch is a focused monitoring and benchmarking tool that excels at multi-engine tracking and competitive share-of-voice analysis.
